questions.stem: A 2 kW kettle is connected to a 230 V supply. Which fuse should be used?
questions.explanation: Current = P/V = 2000/230 = 8.7 A. The fuse rating must be slightly above the normal operating current. A 10 A or 13 A fuse would work, but standard UK fuse ratings are 3 A or 13 A, so a 13 A fuse is correct.
